record.question: Housefly acts as mechanical vector for transmission of all of the following infections, EXCEPT:
record.explanation: Answer D: Hepatitis B. Houseflies can mechanically carry fecal pathogens associated with enteric disease, whereas HBV transmission is through infected blood and certain body fluids, not food or water. Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/hepatitis-b/prevention/index.html; https://www.cdc.gov/hepatitis-b/hcp/clinical-overview/index.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
